known_information: Issue: Labels: bug compatibility Windows 11 Intel DSA Environment Windows 11 Pro Version: 26200.7623 (Fast Startup enabled) PowerToys Version: Latest stable release (≥v0.95.0) 360 Extreme Browser Version: v23.1.1187.64 (custom Chromium kernel) Intel DSA Status: Enabled (driver 25.4.36.6; runs as system service only, no full initialization after Fast Startup) Hardware Check: Memory test passed; CPU idle temp < 60℃; stable power supply Problem Details The conflict only occurs when all three components coexist. Uninstalling any one of them resolves all issues completely: After launching PowerToys, 360 Extreme Browser fails to start normally. 360ChromeX.exe enters a 5-minute start-terminate loop (≈150 PID changes, single process lifespan ≤2s), then stops automatically with zero successful launches. 360 Extreme Browser launches normally if Intel DSA finishes starting before PowerToys. With Fast Startup enabled, Intel DSA only runs as a service (no full initialization) on boot, leading to browser launch failure when paired with PowerToys. 360 Extreme Browser works normally if all PowerToys functional components are disabled (only PowerToys.exe main process runs). 360 Extreme Browser works normally if PowerToys auto-start is disabled and launched manually after full system boot. Repeated browser launch tests trigger unexpected system power-off and reboot. 360 Extreme Browser can launch and run normally if opened before PowerToys finishes loading all components. Once PowerToys is fully started, the already running browser crashes immediately, and new launches fail. Reproduction Steps Keep Windows Fast Startup enabled; confirm Intel DSA runs as system service only (no full initialization on boot). Install 360 Extreme Browser v23.1.1187.64 and latest PowerToys (all components enabled by default). Boot the system normally and wait for PowerToys to fully start. Attempt to launch 360 Extreme Browser → observe the 5-minute process loop. Uninstall any one of the three components, reboot the system → 360 Extreme Browser launches normally. Logs & Evidence Browser Crash Log (Event ID 1000) Faulting App: 360ChromeX.exe (v23.1.1187.64) Faulting Module: chrome.dll (v23.1.1187.64) Exception Code: 0xc000001d Paths: C:\Program Files (x86)\360Chrome\Chrome\Application\360ChromeX.exe / C:\Program Files (x86)\360Chrome\Chrome\Application\chrome.dll System Reboot Log (Event ID 41, Kernel-Power) Trigger: After 3+ rounds of browser launch tests Description: "The system has rebooted without cleanly shutting down first. This error could be caused by the system stopping responding, crashing, or losing power unexpectedly." PowerToys Startup Resource Log Before PowerToys full load: System handle count ≈4000 → browser runs normally After PowerToys full load: System handle count spikes to 10000+ → browser crashes immediately Additional Notes The above content is summarized by AI; please refer to the attachment for detailed process data. Official Chrome/Edge browsers show no such issues when paired with Intel DSA + PowerToys. The log content contains Chinese. Please use a translation tool to read it. Please let me know if you need any additional information. Thank you for your replies and assistance. General Steps to reproduce 【三方共存冲突】Intel DSA + PowerToys 导致 360 极速浏览器无法启动，在三者共存的情况下，360极速浏览器无法启动，如果删掉Intel DSA或PowerToys 则剩余两者都正常。***（你是三个安装在电脑上就启动不了还是三个没办法同时运行？你的删掉是卸载的意思还是关闭的意思？）*** 我反馈的这个问题目前在PowerToys 0.92.1-x64时没有问题可以正常打开浏览器，但我升级0.95.1的时候，保留PowerToy时打不开浏览器，但是当PowerToy和Intel DSA先启动，再打开浏览器时就能正常打开。0.96.1版本问题依旧。 （ 这段繁琐至极逻辑不清。***我理一下可能是下面的意思，但是这又和上一段冲突了哥们*** - 已知在PowerToys 0.92.1时，三者均能正常运行。 - 但在我更新PowerToys至0.95.1后，仅PowerToys在后台运行时会导致360急速浏览器无法启动。 - 在0.95.1版本前提下，如果我先行启动PowerToy和Intel DSA，360急速浏览器又能正常启动。 - 直到目前PowerToys的0.96.1版本该问题依然存在。 ） 我是笔记本电脑，当切换成独显时大概率可以打开极速浏览器，但混合时大概率会打不开，需要重启一下，让Intel DSA也打开，才能正常打开360极速浏览器。（这段也是炸裂至极，又是大量自然语言，我不想再多言） ✔️ Expected Behavior Powertoys可以和360极速浏览器共存，两者不再冲突。***（你到底是三者共存还是两者共存，Intel DSA是和事佬吗，为什么你Steps to reproduce说三者共存冲突，不是我凭空无故的怀疑，哥们你真有过义务教育九年吗）*** ❌ Actual Behavior 当Powertoys打开时，360极速浏览器有概率打不开。 有可能两者有抢占端口的情况出现，而Intel DSA的存在调和了这种冲突？***（什么软件间调和不调和的，这里可没这种说法，你还帮开发者猜呢，你前面都说了PowerToy和Intel DSA先启动360急速浏览器正常，我搞不懂你这里猜是何意味）*** Additional Information OS version：Win11 Pro 25H2 26200.7462 .net version：8.0 360极速浏览器 version：23.1.1137.64(x64) Chromium内核版本:132.0.6805.0 Intel DSA version：25.4.36.6（依赖.net8.0）
